svg.title: Player board RED advanced
svg.text: RED - ADVANCED SIDE (adds Docks, Ports and the market)
Take the coins off your buildings (they can work again).
Extract: 1 token of the tile's resource
Factory: 1 iron = 2 Bots, or iron + crystal = 1 Mech
Trade at your Dock or a Port (current price)
Buy a Mission (+1 for each you have bought)
A coin on a building or post = used this turn. Take coins off at the start of your turn.
